The problem

Good equipment is out of reach, and banks say no.

Rain decides the harvest

Without irrigation, farmers lose seasons and income, or burn costly diesel to keep pumps running.

Produce spoils

Small processors and traders lose stock without cold storage and reliable power.

No credit history

Informal earners have no payslips or collateral, so traditional lenders turn them away.

How it works

From first visit to first harvest in four steps.

1

Meet your agent

A trained local agent visits, checks your needs and shows how the payback works.

2

Pay a small deposit

Put down a modest deposit by mobile money. We approve based on your farm or business.

3

Get installed

We install and train you on the equipment, and the smart module starts recording use.

4

Pay as you earn

Pay weekly or monthly until it is yours. Good records unlock bigger equipment later.

Questions

Straight answers.

What happens if I miss a payment?

You get reminders and a grace period first. We work out a plan with you before any lock, especially around harvest timing.

Who owns the equipment?

You own it once the final payment is made. Until then it is financed by Kilowatta and our lenders.

What if the equipment breaks?

Contact your local agent. Repairs start within 72 hours of your report. Warranty: pumps and cold-storage compressors 24 months; batteries 24 months; controllers and inverters 12 months; solar panels 10 years against defects; installation and wiring 12 months. Cover stays valid while your payments are up to date and excludes misuse, theft, flooding and unauthorised repairs.

Do I need a smartphone?

No. You can use basic SMS or USSD to pay and check your account.
